snippet.title: Civil War - (1968)  {101 Basic Computer Games} [31]
snippet.description:
Name: Civil War
Developer: Larry Cram, Luther Goodie and Doug Hibbard
Year: 1968
Simulation Available. 1 player. 
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
In Civil War, the player takes command of the Confederate or the Union army in one of 14 battles of the US Civil War.

Civil War was coded by three students  In 1968 at Lexington High School. The game was saved from oblivion by David Ahl’s 101 Basic Computer Games. The initial version of the game was one page long and even simpler than this one (it was solitaire only and the battles had to be played in order) but included a final tally after the 14th battle.
___________________________________________________________________________
Comment: Not the most interesting game, but part of the history of video games.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

As always you can play and download the game here: 
https://archive.org/details/civilwar.qb64

More info here:
https://zeitgame.net/archives/7631
